# Slipway

> Index for language models and coding assistants interacting with the Slipway repository and site.

## Resources

- [Slipway GitHub Repository](https://github.com/arminazimi/slipway): Official source code and documentation.

## AI Agent Indexing

- Follows the standard /llms.txt specification for language model indexing.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
